name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport IT began unexpectedly during a university internship at a local racing team's headquarters. While pursuing his computer science degree, he discovered a passion for optimizing data systems that directly contributed to on-track performance. After graduating, he honed his skills in network administration and cybersecurity before returning to the motorsport world.

Thabo thrives on implementing innovative solutions to keep IT infrastructure secure and efficient. He believes in a proactive approach to problem-solving, constantly seeking ways to improve system performance and minimize downtime. What sets him apart is his relentless dedication to ensuring the team's data integrity and accessibility, knowing that every bit of information can be the key to victory.

physical.description: Thabo is a powerfully built man with a focused gaze.
